Whenever a Princess character of yours sings a song, gain lore equal to her {L}.

cards.name: Pocahontas
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Pocahontas - Peacekeeper in your deck.)

Once during your turn, you may choose a character. Until the start of your next turn, they get +1 {L} and can’t challenge and must quest if able.

cards.name: Stitch
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Stitch - Rock Star in your deck.)

Once during your turn, you may play a character with cost 2 or less from your hand for free. If you have a character named Stitch in play, you may play a character with cost 2 or less from your discard for free instead.

cards.name: Donald Duck
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Donald Duck - Fred Honeywell in your deck.)

You pay 1 {I} less to use Boost abilities.

cards.name: Robin Hood
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Robin Hood - Sneaky Sleuth in your deck.)

Once per game during your turn, you may deal 1 damage to each opposing character.

cards.name: Ursula
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Ursula - Deceiver of All in your deck.)

Your characters count as having +1 cost for singing songs. Your characters named Ursula count as having +2 cost instead.

cards.name: Moana
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Moana - Curious Explorer in your deck.)

During your turn, if you have a Moana, Heihei, or Pua character in play, you may ink an additional card.

cards.name: Mufasa
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Mufasa - Ruler of Pride Rock in your deck.)

Once per game during your turn, you may pay 5 {I} to put the top 3 cards of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Nick Wilde
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Nick Wilde - Wily Fox in your deck.)

You can have up to 4 copies of an item card named Pawbsicle in your deck.

Once during your turn, you may banish 4 of your items. If you do, gain 4 lore.

cards.name: Dumbo
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe in your deck.)

You may use the {E} abilities of your characters the turn they’re played.

cards.name: Snow White
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Snow White - Merry as the Morning in your deck.)

Once per game during your turn, you may reveal your hand. If you have a Snow White and 7 or more Seven Dwarfs character cards with different names among the cards in your hand, in your discard, and in play, your characters get +2 {L} for the rest of the game.

cards.name: Winnie the Pooh
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Winnie the Pooh - Hunny Wizard in your deck.)

Whenever you play a character without an ability, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card.

cards.name: Mickey Mouse
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Mickey Mouse - Brave Little Tailor in your deck.)

Mickey Mouse character cards in your hand, deck, and discard gain Shift 2 {I}.

cards.name: Mr. Incredible
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Mr. Incredible - Super Strong in your deck.)

Whenever you play a Super character, they gain Rush this turn and you may exert chosen opposing character with less {S} than them.

cards.name: Sisu
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Sisu - Emboldened Warrior in your deck.)

All characters with more {S} than each opposing character can quest the turn they’re played.

cards.name: John Silver
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of John Silver - Greedy Treasure Seeker in your deck.)

Each of your locations gains Resist +1 for each character there.

cards.name: Scar
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Scar - Finally King in your deck.)

During your turn, you pay 1 {I} less for the first Ally character you play.

cards.name: Tinker Bell
cards.rules_text:
(You can have up to 4 copies of Tinker Bell - Giant Fairy in your deck.)

Whenever one of your other abilities or actions deals damage to an opposing character, deal 1 damage to that character.

cards.name: Beast
cards.rules_text:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they’re played.)
DYNAMIC MANEUVER Whenever this character challenges, if he’s at a location, he takes no damage from the challenge.

cards.name: Rapunzel
cards.rules_text:
Boost 2 {I} (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 {I} to put the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
CLONK! Whenever this character quests, if there’s a card under her, chosen opposing character can’t challenge until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Pocahontas
cards.rules_text: STAY CLOSE When you play this character, you may play a character with cost 1 for free.

cards.name: Vixey
cards.rules_text: STEALING IN When you play this character, if you have a character with Evasive in play, you may return chosen character, item, or location with cost 2 or less to their player’s hand.

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear
cards.rules_text:
ACTION FIGURE When you play this character, choose one of the following. If you have another Toy character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return an action card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.
• You may play an action with cost 2 or less for free.

cards.name: Boo
cards.rules_text:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
KID-TASTROPHE! Whenever this character challenges another character with 3 {S} or less, banish that character. (No damage is dealt in that challenge.)

cards.name: Merlin
cards.rules_text:
MINOR TRICKERY When you play this character, you may draw a card from the bottom of your deck.
AGE OF INCONVENIENCE When this character is banished, put this card from your discard on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Maximus
cards.rules_text: NO ESCAPE If you discarded a card this turn, this character gains Challenger +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)
